intro: 12 個通信情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: Her assistant copied and assembled the documents.
ex.zh: 她的助理把文件影印並彙整起來。

ex.en: The mail room clerk read the directions before assembling the parts to the new postage printer.
ex.zh: 收發室職員在組裝新郵資印表機的零件前先讀了說明。

note: assembly 集會、組裝;assembly line 生產線

ex.en: To speed up the mailing, we should prepare the labels beforehand.
ex.zh: 為加快郵寄速度,我們應該事先準備好標籤。

ex.en: The goods could have been shipped today had they given us the order beforehand.
ex.zh: 如果他們事先把訂單給我們,貨今天就能出了。

note: 置於句尾的副詞,不接名詞

ex.en: There was a complication with the delivery because the address was written incorrectly.
ex.zh: 因為地址寫錯了,配送出現了狀況。

ex.en: Complications always arise when we try to cover too many topics in one letter.
ex.zh: 當我們想在一封信裡涵蓋太多主題時,總會出現複雜的問題。

note: complicate 使複雜;complicated 複雜的

ex.en: We hired a courier to deliver the package.
ex.zh: 我們雇了一位快遞來送這個包裹。

ex.en: The courier service will clear the goods through customs.
ex.zh: 這家快遞公司會替貨物辦理通關。

note: courier service 快遞服務;by courier 以快遞方式

ex.en: We no longer distribute our newsletter by mail because everyone reads it online.
ex.zh: 我們不再以郵寄方式分發電子報,因為大家都在線上閱讀。

ex.en: We plan to distribute copies of the announcement throughout the building.
ex.zh: 我們打算把公告的影本分送到整棟大樓各處。

note: distribution 分發、配銷;distributor 經銷商
distribute sth to sb 把某物分發給某人

ex.en: It's important that this document be there tomorrow, so please send it express mail.
ex.zh: 這份文件明天務必送達,所以請用快遞寄出。

ex.en: Express mail costs more than regular mail service, but it is more efficient.
ex.zh: 快遞郵件比一般郵遞貴,但效率更高。

note: 當動詞時意為「表達」,express an opinion

ex.en: Fold the letter into three parts before stuffing it into the envelope.
ex.zh: 把信紙摺成三摺再塞進信封。

ex.en: Don't fold the document if it doesn't fit the envelope.
ex.zh: 如果文件放不進信封,也不要把它摺起來。

note: fold in half / into three 摺成兩摺或三摺

ex.en: We had to change the layout when we changed the size of the paper.
ex.zh: 我們更改紙張尺寸時,必須跟著調整版面配置。

ex.en: The layout for the new brochure was submitted by the designer.
ex.zh: 新手冊的版面設計已由設計師提交。

note: 名詞寫在一起 layout;動詞分開 lay out

ex.en: There was no mention of the cost in the proposal.
ex.zh: 提案中完全沒有提到成本。

ex.en: You should mention in the letter that we can arrange for mailing the brochures as well as printing them.
ex.zh: 你應該在信中提到,我們除了印製手冊外也能安排寄送。

note: make mention of sth;not to mention 更不用說
mention sth to sb,不說 mention sb sth

ex.en: The petition was photocopied and distributed to workers who will collect the necessary signatures.
ex.zh: 這份請願書已影印並分發給負責收集必要簽名的員工。

ex.en: We petitioned the postal officials to start delivering mail twice a day in business areas.
ex.zh: 我們向郵政官員請願,要求在商業區每天送兩次信。

note: petition sb to V 向某人請願做⋯

ex.en: This letter was not proofed very carefully; it is full of errors.
ex.zh: 這封信沒有仔細校對,錯誤百出。

ex.en: Please proof the memo one more time before you distribute it.
ex.zh: 分發這份備忘錄前請再校對一次。

note: 當名詞時意為證據、證明

ex.en: The brochure was revised several times before it was sent to the printer.
ex.zh: 這本手冊在送印前修改了好幾次。

ex.en: We will need to revise the form letter since our address has changed.
ex.zh: 由於我們地址變更,必須修改這份制式信函。
